articles.full_text:
A 17-year-old Class 11 student from Uttar Pradesh’s Ghaziabad died after slipping down a steep slope while taking photographs near Rohtang Pass in Himachal Pradesh’s Kullu district on Tuesday, ETV Bharat reported, citing police.
Police identified the teenager as Rudra Kumar. The report said he had travelled to Manali with his classmates and had gone near a hillside to click pictures when he lost his footing and fell into a deep gorge.
Keylong DSP KD Sharma was cited as saying that the group comprised Class 11 Commerce students of Brightland School in Ghaziabad’s Govindpuram. According to the DSP, the students had headed towards Rohtang Pass in the afternoon, and Rudra went near a hillside on the other side of the pass for the photographs.
A Lahaul police team reached the spot after being informed, took possession of the body and began further proceedings, the report added.
The DSP said the boy’s family has been informed and a post-mortem examination is under way. As per the report, the body will be handed over to the family in accordance with the rules once the post-mortem and other legal formalities are completed.
Police are also questioning the students who accompanied Rudra, the DSP said. He added that the investigation is continuing and further action is being taken.
